import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    B = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]

    freq = {}
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd:
            cost = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1])
            freq[cost] = freq.get(cost, 0) + 1

    budget = B
    ans = 0
    if budget >= 0:
        for cost, count in sorted(freq.items()):
            for _ in range(count):
                budget -= cost
                if budget < 0:
                    break
                ans += 1
            if budget < 0:
                break
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
